subject: AWS Offer listing: visibility + SKU mapping & co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: AWS offer visibility & SKU mapping draft (first pass)

Hi team — attaching the first-pass product page and SKU map for the Acme Analytics listing (RDW-8732). Can you review for: headline/1-liner accuracy, feature bullets, pricing SKU names, and the co-sell callout? Key asks below.

Attachments: product_page_draft.md, pricing-sku-matrix.csv, co-sell-one-pager.pdf

Quick context: Acme is targeting a Dec 1 go-live to align with their Q4 renewals. We need listing copy + SKU mapping finalized so I can push assets into the AWS console and share with the Partner SA.

Please review sections and flag any legal/product claims (latency, throughput) that need to be toned down. Also: confirm the pricing SKUs map cleanly to Dedicated vs Hosted usage buckets — there's one open question around the "Burst" SKU (line-item in matrix).

Proposed timeline: comments back by EOD Thu (11/19), then Vanessa to coordinate quick sync with AWS if needed.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS offer visibility & SKU mapping draft (first pass)

Thanks Marissa — good start. Inline notes below.

On Wed, 18 Nov 2026 at 09:03, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see attachments)

> Headline / 1-liner: 
> "High-throughput, low-latency LLM inference for product teams"

> - Suggest: soften to "predictable, production-grade LLM inference" — we should avoid a hard latency claim unless benchmarked per SKU.

> Feature bullets: caching / routing / quantization notes
> - Agree with bullets, but remove the specific "<10ms" claim in the feature list. Put benchmark callout in a separate performance note with a link to our public benchmarks.

> SKU map: see pricing-sku-matrix.csv
> - "Burst" SKU: prefer to call it "Burst credits" not a separate SKU line. Keeps billing simpler for enterprise procurement.

> Co-sell callout: add expected SA involvement (1-2 hrs pre-sale + onboarding handoff) and a support SLA for co-sell customers.

Other items:
- Remove BYOK/KMS references from the public listing — that is a private deployment capability and confuses marketplace buyers.
- Add an explicit "expected throughput" row to the SKU matrix (example profile: 20 reqs/sec sustained, 500 token median).
- Recommend we include 2 customer logos (Acme Pilot + one neutral) in the product page if legal approves.

I'll mark up product_page_draft.md and push a v2 later today.

Mina
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sam Wright <sam.wright@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Jenkins <lauren.jenkins@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS offer visibility & SKU mapping draft (first pass)

Looping in Sam from Acme here so they're aware of the copy changes. Also cc'd Lauren Jenkins from AWS (partner manager).

I've attached an updated product page (product_page_v2.md) that integrates Mina's headline adjustment and removes the BYOK mentions. I also renamed the "Burst" line to "Burst credits" and added the throughput row to the SKU matrix (see updated CSV).

Vanessa notes:
- Co-sell blurb: include an explicit "Co-sell eligible" badge and a 2-line summary of what our SA will do during an opportunity. That helps AWS channel teams quickly route.
- Pricing tiers: prefer the following public labels: Starter, Scale, Dedicated (instead of Pro/Enterprise). Keeps alignment with our pricing model.
- For marketplace listing assets: we should surface a one-page co-sell checklist (attached) so AWS knows the expected customer success handoffs.

Can we set a 30-minute sync with Lauren next week to validate the co-sell badge and SA expectations? Proposed slots: Mon 11/22 10:00-10:30 PT or Tue 11/23 14:00-14:30 PT. I can book once I hear from Lauren.

Attachments: product_page_v2.md

Thanks — Vanessa
Go-to-Market, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Lauren Jenkins <lauren.jenkins@amazon.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sam Wright <sam.wright@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS offer visibility & SKU mapping draft (first pass)

Thanks for the update — happy to help get this across the finish line. A few quick items from the AWS side:

1) Co-sell badging: we can surface a "Co-sell eligible" badge on the product page, but we need a short statement (1-2 lines) describing SA involvement and the expected customer handoff. Your suggested blurb looks fine — please include a contact email and "typical SA commitment" (e.g., 1–2 hours pre-sales).

2) Technical contact: the marketplace listing requires a technical contact + email for listing verification. Please confirm who will be listed (name, title, email).

3) Docs & MOU: I'll send a DocuSign link for the co-sell MOU and the go-to-market plan. We typically request signed MOU 5 business days before the requested go-live. Link will follow.

4) Launch timing: if you want Dec 1 live, we need final copy and the SKU matrix by Nov 27. Any missing fields (NDA-sensitive logos or pricing breakouts) will delay approval.

Proposed quick sync: Mon 11/22 10:00 PT works for me. Lauren (AWS) — confirm and I'll accept the invite.

Lauren Jenkins
Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
lauren.jenkins@amazon.com

On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 10:05 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see product_page_v2.md attached)
